title: Pure Mokey Mokey
summary: Belowski's Mokey Mokey archetype is a Level 1 LIGHT Fairy Normal Monster OTK and Fusion swarm deck supercharged by Mokey Mokey Adrift! Discard Mokey Mokey Adrift from your hand to add ANY 'Mokey Mokey' card from your Deck to your hand (searching Mokey Mokey Smackdown!) while simultaneously putting Adrift into your GY as a 'Mokey Mokey' Normal Monster. When you Normal or Special Summon Mokey Mokey Adrift and Tribute it, it revives as many 'Mokey Mokey' monsters as possible from your GY! Activate Mokey Mokey Smackdown and destroy 1 Fairy you control to immediately boost EVERY Mokey Mokey on your field to 3000 ATK for a massive OTK, or fuse 3 Mokey Mokeys into Mokey Mokey King!

allow.The Agent of Creation - Venus: Level 3 LIGHT Fairy that pays 500 LP to summon Mystical Shine Balls and provides a LIGHT Fairy body on the field that can be destroyed or crashed in battle to trigger Mokey Mokey Smackdown.
allow.Mystical Shine Ball: Level 2 LIGHT Fairy Normal Monster summoned by Venus to crash into an opponent's monster to trigger Mokey Mokey Smackdown.
allow.Unexpected Dai: Special Summons Level 1 Normal Monster Mokey Mokey directly from your Deck while you control no monsters.
allow.Rescue Rabbit: Banishes itself to Special Summon 2 copies of Mokey Mokey directly from your Deck.
allow.Painful Decision: Sends 1 Mokey Mokey from your Deck to the GY to add another Mokey Mokey to your hand while stocking the GY for Mokey Mokey Adrift's mass revival!
allow.Polymerization: Fuses 3 Mokey Mokey into Mokey Mokey King while loading Mokey Mokeys into the GY for Mokey Mokey King's float and Mokey Mokey Adrift!
allow.Fusion Deployment: Reveals Mokey Mokey King in the Extra Deck to Special Summon Mokey Mokey directly from your hand or Deck!
allow.One for One: Limited to 1 in TCG: discards 1 monster to Special Summon Mokey Mokey Adrift or Mokey Mokey directly from your Deck.
allow.First of the Dragons: Level 9 Fusion summoned via Polymerization using 2 Normal Monster Mokey Mokeys that is unaffected by monster effects.
allow.Link Spider: Link-1 monster summoned using a Normal Monster Mokey Mokey to Special Summon another Mokey Mokey from your hand.

main: Mokey Mokey

Iconic Level 1 LIGHT Fairy Normal Monster (300 ATK / 100 DEF): summoned from the Deck via Unexpected Dai, Rescue Rabbit, and Fusion Deployment, and reaches 3000 ATK whenever Mokey Mokey Smackdown triggers!
Mokey Mokey Adrift

Core Level 1 LIGHT Fairy: treated as 'Mokey Mokey' and as a Normal Monster while on the field or in the GY; discards itself to add ANY 'Mokey Mokey' card from your Deck to your hand; and Tributes itself to revive as many 'Mokey Mokey' monsters as possible from your GY!
Mokey Mokey Smackdown

Signature Continuous Spell: while you control a face-up 'Mokey Mokey', if a face-up Fairy monster you control is destroyed by battle or card effect, the ATK of ALL 'Mokey Mokey' monsters you control becomes 3000!
Unexpected Dai
Special Summons Mokey Mokey directly from your Deck while you control no monsters.
Rescue Rabbit
Banishes itself to Special Summon 2 copies of Mokey Mokey from your Deck.
Painful Decision
Sends 1 Mokey Mokey from your Deck to the GY to add a second copy to your hand.
Fusion Deployment
Reveals Mokey Mokey King in your Extra Deck to Special Summon Mokey Mokey directly from your Deck.
Polymerization
Fuses 3 Mokey Mokeys into Mokey Mokey King (or 2 into First of the Dragons).
The Agent of Creation - Venus

LIGHT Fairy starter that summons Mystical Shine Balls to crash in battle—destroying a face-up Fairy you control so Mokey Mokey Smackdown immediately turns all your Mokey Mokeys into 3000 ATK beatsticks!
Mystical Shine Ball
Summoned by Venus to crash into an opponent's monster and trigger Mokey Mokey Smackdown during your Battle Phase.
One for One
Limited to 1 in TCG: Special Summons Mokey Mokey Adrift directly from your Deck.
extra: Signature Level 6 LIGHT Fairy Fusion boss ('Mokey Mokey' + 'Mokey Mokey' + 'Mokey Mokey'): when this card is removed from the field, Special Summons as many 'Mokey Mokey' monsters as possible from your GY!
Level 9 Dragon Fusion made with any 2 Mokey Mokey Normal Monsters via Polymerization.
Link-1 monster that converts Mokey Mokey into an Effect Monster and extends from hand.
